answer: The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in forge, expire in raven, and tundra lists each expiry. Someone running 44 aliases as a result needs 144 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3509 identities would post 1626 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
